provenance: Larry's son's written report, sent to the archive on the evening of 2026-09-05, answering the archive's questions about what Larry said at the table while drawing that afternoon. His son listened and did not take notes, so this is his summary from memory in his own words, not Larry's words.
text: Yes. the left entrance is where the gun man entered, my father was near left and to the bottom of the Shower box, the shower was top of the box, Weaver entered at the far right door entrance. The figures on the bottom would be stalls or toilets that my father was at. North of those would be the Showers where the guy was shot.
researchNotes: Asked whether Larry pointed at the sheet when he said Weaver came in 'from the right side' (2026-09-05-drawing-shower-shooting): he did, and this is his son's account of what he pointed to on the SHOWER box of VD-0001. It gives the box an orientation the sheet does not state: showers along the top, stalls or toilets along the bottom where Larry was, the gunman's entrance at the left, Weaver's at the far right. 'North' is his son's word for the top of the sheet. The two figures drawn on the bottom edge are, by this account, the stalls or toilets, not men. The description of VD-0001 stays as drawn; this is the testimony that reads it. Ledger #11 and #35.
